call_points.text: Domestic branded business is growing at 25% backed by volume growth across all channels.
Gross debt as of September 30, 2026 is ₹1,192 crores and net debt is around ₹742 crores.
Plans to reduce gross debt by another ₹100 Cr to ₹1,000 Cr and net debt to around ₹800 Cr.
Freeze-dried coffee earns 30-40% higher EBITDA than spray-dried; mix shift supports margins.
Green coffee prices volatile at ₹3,300-3,800; El Nino could affect Vietnam crop but supply seen intact.
Logistics and packaging costs rose due to Middle East crisis, impacting standalone India business.
Management guides for 15% volume growth and around 15% EBITDA growth for FY27.
Net debt as of March 31 reduced to around ₹1,073 crores, a reduction of over ₹750 crores.

timeline.summary: India Ratings revised CCL Products' outlook to Stable from Negative while affirming its IND AA- rating.
Promoter **Challa Srishant** declared no share encumbrance under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2025-26 on 03.04.2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,224.44 Cr (+46.5% YoY), net profit ₹114.53 Cr (+12.4% YoY).
CCL Products (India) Limited’s Board, led by Sridevi Dasari, recommended a final dividend of ₹3 per share (150%) for FY 2025-26 on 07.05.2026.
CCL Products reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,226.39 Cr (+46% YoY) and net profit of ₹114.53 Cr (+12% YoY).
CCL Products held its Q1FY27 earnings call on 28 July 2026, reporting 13.76% revenue growth to ₹1,203.59 Cr and 61.31% PAT growth to ₹116.87 Cr, with net debt down to ₹963 Cr.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,210.76 Cr (+7.5% YoY), net profit ₹130.11 Cr (+29.0% YoY).
DASARI Sridevi, on behalf of CCL Products (India) Limited, uploaded Q2 & H1 FY2026-27 results conference call audio on October 16, 2026.
CCL Products reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹1,216 Cr and net profit of ₹130 Cr, maintaining its 15% volume growth guidance.
